head_height.value: Face from top of head to chin must occupy 70% of the photograph

expression_restriction.value: Neutral facial expression, mouth must be closed

face_visibility.value: Frontal view, uncovered forehead, face clearly visible and suitable for biometric capture

headwear_policy.value: No hats, caps, or scarves allowed; exceptions only in exceptional cases (religious/medical)

file_spec.value: Printed on white thin glossy photographic paper, minimum 600 dpi resolution; alternatively, digital photo via e-fotograf system with reference number

size.evidence: The official Slovenian e-uprava page was fetched directly and states: 'Vlogi je potrebno priloziti eno fotografijo velikosti 3,5 x 4,5 cm' (One photograph of size 3.5 x 4.5 cm must be attached). This matches the claimed value of 35 x 45 mm exactly. Multiple independent third-party sources (visafoto.com, mybiometricphotos.com, timpson.co.uk) also consistently cite 35x45mm for Slovenia passport photos.
